reviews.author: noa F…
reviews.body: Nathalys did a flawless job. This is my first time doing Gel X. I usually do gel on natural nails so I was a bit nervous. But she was just incredible!! She took the time to talk and explain, her expertise is top notch and her talent speaks for itself. She listened and knew exactly what I wanted better than I could explain or describe. I trust her with my eyes closed!!! So grateful I found her and excited for my event. Warning ⚠️ side effects may include obsessively and excessively looking at your nails. @itsthenoa
